title: Updating a nested object in state

slides.say: Your state has an object inside an object. You want to change one deep field.
We want to change the city inside artwork. Mutating person dot artwork dot city is off limits.
So copy each level. Spread person, replace artwork with a copy of the old artwork, and set the new city.

slides.text: Spread is shallow, so each level you change needs its own copy.
slides.say: Spread is shallow. Every level on the way to the change needs its own copy. Wordy, but it works.
